rationale: The assistant correctly identified 4C as a water-supply (fill) error, told the customer to unplug and turn off the tap before unscrewing the hose, and ordered checks sensibly: tap, kinks, then inlet mesh filter. It tracked the customer's findings exactly, never invented evidence, and the clogged filter was cleaned and the fault cleared, matching the hidden truth. Minor repetition of 'almost always caused by restricted water flow' across turns, and the image card described the filter at the tap end while the customer was correctly working at the machine end, but neither hindered progress. No parts were recommended and escalation was appropriately held in reserve.
